title: Circadian PERIOD proteins regulate TC-DSB repair through anchoring to the nuclear envelope
authors: Le Bozec B; Guitton-Sert L; Collins S; Finoux A; Payrault C; Frison J; Carette R; Rocher V; Guillou E; Arnould C; Guénolé A; Aguirrebengoa M; Aguirrebengoa M; Lazar I; Marnef A; Frit P; Calsou P; Mangeat T; Puget N; Legube G
one_liner_zh: 该文研究昼夜节律PERIOD蛋白在转录偶联DSB修复中锚定核膜的作用，属于DNA损伤修复机制，未涉及蛋白质-DNA结合建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Repair of DNA Double-Strand Breaks (DSBs) produced in transcriptionally active chromatin occurs through a poorly characterized pathway called Transcription-Coupled DSB repair (TC-DSBR). Here, using a screening approach scoring multiple outputs in human cells, we identified proteins from the PERIOD complex, a key module ensuring circadian oscillations, as novel TC-DSBR players. We show that the core PER complex protein PER2 is recruited at TC-DSBs and that it contributes to the targeting of TC-DSBs at the nuclear envelope (NE). At the NE, SUN1 and the Nuclear Pore Complex (NPC) act as docking sites for TC-DSBs and TC-DSB anchoring fosters RAD51 assembly. Impaired DSB localization at the NE results in elevated DSB clustering and translocation rate. In agreement, the circadian clock regulates TC-DSB anchoring to the NE, RAD51 assembly, and DSB clustering. Our study shows that DSB localization to the NPC is a conserved molecular pathway that also occurs in human cells and provides a direct link between the circadian rhythm and the response to DSBs occurring in active genes. This opens new therapeutic strategies for chemotherapies based on drugs that are inducing DSBs in active loci such as topoisomerase poisons.
abstract_zh: 转录活跃染色质中产生的DNA双链断裂（DSBs）的修复通过一种称为转录偶联DSB修复（TC-DSBR）的机制进行，该机制尚未被充分表征。在此，我们采用一种在人类细胞中评估多种输出的筛选方法，鉴定了PERIOD复合体（一个确保昼夜节律振荡的关键模块）中的蛋白质作为新型TC-DSBR参与者。我们展示了核心PER复合体蛋白PER2被招募至TC-DSBs，并促进TC-DSBs靶向核膜（NE）。在核膜处，SUN1和核孔复合体（NPC）作为TC-DSBs的对接位点，且TC-DSB锚定促进RAD51组装。DSB在核膜处的定位受损导致DSB聚集和易位率升高。与此一致，昼夜节律调节TC-DSB在核膜处的锚定、RAD51组装及DSB聚集。我们的研究表明，DSB定位至NPC是一个保守的分子通路，在人类细胞中同样发生，并提供了昼夜节律与活跃基因中DSB反应之间的直接联系。这为基于诱导活跃位点DSB的药物（如拓扑异构酶毒剂）的化疗开辟了新的治疗策略。
